loader_audit.row_identity_scope: Ordered original payload bytes, canonical data-file paths and part IDs; no label-based selection or added RNG.
loader_audit.timestamp_scope: Time inferred at full_timestamp_seq[seq_len]; no independent target-time check. Full side sequences physically decoded, including later values; only retained prefix and target used.
loader_audit.task_mask_scope: Unknown behavior task masks are zero because no positive behavior is observed; this does not mean known negative. Actual action inputs carry categories 17/18.

cost_scope: Explicit --run entry through all model artifacts, excluding read-only preflight and final completion serialization; peak RSS is whole process high-water mark.
